_about: External reference values the platform compares its own figures against (SPEC.md §5.35). Not data: each comes from a dated publication and changes only with a new edition, through a reviewed PR (change the entry, rerun the stages that compare against it, re-check docs/training). The monthly refresh flags an entry past its review_by date, and a missed heartbeat of the monthly reference-search routine. Earlier values stay in git history.

heartbeat._note: issue: the number of the pinned 'Monthly reference check' issue (#111) the reference-search routine comments on every run (SPEC.md §5.35 H; the claude.ai routine 'Monthly reference check', 1st of each month 14:00 UTC). Set to null to switch the heartbeat check off; the refresh then only notes that it is not configured.

ipcc_ar6_tcre.citation: IPCC AR6 WGI: transient climate response to cumulative CO2 emissions (likely range 1.0-2.3 °C per 1,000 GtC, best estimate 1.65).
ipcc_ar6_tcre.what_it_is: The IPCC's assessed transient climate response to cumulative CO2 emissions (TCRE): warming per 1,000 GtCO2 emitted.
ipcc_ar6_tcre.what_it_is_not: Derived from CO2-only forcing in Earth-system models with land-use emissions included; this platform's figure is a simplified, data-driven analog, not a restatement.

paris_temperature_goals.baseline: 1850-1900, the IPCC's approximation of pre-industrial (the platform's temperature reference)
paris_temperature_goals.citation: Paris Agreement (UNFCCC, 2015), Article 2.1(a): holding warming well below 2 °C above pre-industrial levels and pursuing efforts to limit it to 1.5 °C.
paris_temperature_goals.what_it_is: The Paris Agreement's long-term temperature goals: well below 2 °C, pursuing 1.5 °C, above pre-industrial levels.
paris_temperature_goals.what_it_is_not: The goals refer to long-term global warming, which the IPCC assesses on 20-year averages. An illustrative pathway's implied level for one year reaching 1.5 °C or 2 °C is not the goal being crossed.
paris_temperature_goals.successor: a COP decision or IPCC assessment changing how the goals are assessed
